children: Interest-rate futures now place the odds of a September rate hike at 87%, up from 72% yesterday. Today's inflation number came in as expected, while fuel prices remain elevated.
The likelihood of at least one interest rate hike by year-end is now 97%, up from 94% a day ago.
The FOMC will convene on Sept. 16.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
